title: Willie Lewis's band fighting in Portugal
summary: Butler had been at Teddy Hill's Minton's, and heard that Willie Lewis's band, working in Portugal's casino, fought among themselves instead of staying out of the war.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: down there and at that time, I was on the Hill. See, I am with the aristocrats. I'd met Willie Lewis and them, they had been in Harlem there and then they went to Portugal and got, something happened, they got to fighting, of all places, fighting in Portugal and there's no where to go and they gone get to fighting and they working that beautiful casino and they the bass player is fighting with the trumpet player.
Now, one of the bass players way on the other side of the bandstand and they cussing and calling each other all kinds of names and saying, 'These people don't understand what we saying.'

And all those people are jet people, jet-set people and, they could have been there all through the war and made money because the money they was making was gold money and was three times -- they was something else.
